description: Structured support-ticket triage record extracted from a raw complaint.

severity.description: Triage bucket for the routing queue.

customer.description: Who is affected, as identified in the message.

orders.description: Every order number referenced in the message, if any.

refund_requested.description: Refund amount as written in the message (e.g. "49.90 EUR"), or null when no refund is requested.
